source: written for this kit from workloads/project-tracker-xl/instruction.md only; generated by scripts/gen-hidden-tests-manifest.mjs, one <area>.test.ts per area of workloads/project-tracker-xl/areas.json

tests.name: register returns the user with a trimmed, lowercased email and never a password or hash
register rejects invalid emails, passwords, names, handles and bodies
register accepts boundary values: password 8 and 200 chars, name 100 chars, handle 3 and 20 chars
email_taken is case-insensitive and is checked before handle_taken
login returns a fresh token of at least 20 chars, not starting with trk_, with expiresAt = now + tokenTtlMs
login answers 401 invalid_credentials for a wrong password or unknown email, 400 for non-string fields
authenticated routes answer 401 unauthorized for a missing, malformed, unknown or revoked token
a token expires when now() >= issuedAt + tokenTtlMs
logout answers 204 with no body and revokes only the calling token
POST /me/password validates both fields first, then wrong_password; success revokes every session token but no API key
PATCH /me updates name and handle; another user's handle is 409 handle_taken, one's own is fine
POST /teams makes the caller owner on the defaultPlan; GET /teams lists only the caller's teams, in creation order, with myRole
non-members get 404 not_found, never 403, on every team-scoped route
role checks: member and viewer get 403 on admin+ routes, admin gets 403 on owner-only routes
GET members lists the member shape, oldest joinedAt first
adding a member: bad email or role is 400, unknown email 404 user_not_found, an existing member 409 already_member
the members quota is checked after already_member: a free team of 5 refuses a 6th with quota_exceeded details
PATCH a member's role: admin, member or viewer only; a userId that is not a member is 404
changing the owner's role or removing the owner is 409 owner_required, even by the owner
members may remove themselves; removing someone else needs admin+; member.added and member.removed go through the pipeline
leaving cascades: cards unassigned (archived ones too), watching, private views, timer and user field values go, nothing else changes
transfer makes the target owner and the caller admin, and answers the team as the caller now sees it
transfer to a non-member, an unknown id, oneself or without userId is 400 invalid_body
deleting a team removes it and everything in it for every member
POST project answers the project shape with archived false and description defaulting to empty
a key must match ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,5}$ exactly
keys are unique within a team (archived included) and freed by delete; the projects quota comes after key_taken
PATCH updates name, description and archived and moves updatedAt; a key in the body is 400
GET projects filters by ?archived=false|true|all (default false), oldest first; other values are 400 invalid_query
an archived project answers 409 project_archived on every write inside it; watching still works and reads are unchanged
in an archived project comment writes are refused, a running timer can be stopped and its entry deleted; unarchiving restores writes
project_archived is checked after visibility, role and validation (steps 5-8) and before the route's other 409s
DELETE project removes everything in it: boards, cards, fields, sprints, templates, dependencies, storage, and disables rules on it
a new board gets the default columns To do, In progress, Done at positions 0..2 with categories todo, in_progress, done
columns given on create keep array order and get categories by position; 0 or 21 columns or a bad name is 400
boards list oldest first; PATCH renames a board
adding a column at a position shifts the later columns right; default is the end and category todo
PATCH a column's position moves it and keeps the others' relative order
wipLimit is null or an integer from 1 to 1000 and category one of todo, in_progress, done; a limit may go below the card count
a column becoming a done column completes its cards, and leaving done clears them, as a silent cascade
DELETE column: the last column is 409 last_column; non-archived cards make it 409 column_not_empty; archived ones go to position 0
DELETE column ?moveTo appends its cards to the end of the target, in order, ignoring the WIP limit, with the completion rule
an invalid ?moveTo is 400 invalid_query, even for an empty column or a board's last column
members and viewers get 403 on board and column writes; an admin's write-scope API key gets insufficient_scope
DELETE board removes its columns, cards and recurrences
deleting a column moves its recurrences to moveTo or deletes them, and disables the rules that reference it
a card has the documented shape and defaults, key <project key>-<number> and createdBy
card numbers count per project across its boards and are never reused after a delete
labels are trimmed, lowercased, de-duplicated and sorted; more than 10 distinct is 400
title, description, dueDate, priority, points and sprintId validation, including impossible calendar dates
assigneeId must be an owner, admin or member; the validation order is invalid_body, invalid_assignee, then field values
creating at a position shifts later cards down; deleting closes the gap; neighbours keep updatedAt
moving a card to another column of the same board puts it at the requested index; other boards and bad bodies are 400
moving within a column reorders it, keeps the others' order, and still emits card.moved and a history entry
completedAt is set on entering a done column, kept between done columns and on reorder, and cleared on leaving
a blocked card cannot move into a done column (409 blocked, before the WIP limit) but can be created there, move between done columns and leave
creating in or moving into a full column is 409 wip_limit_reached; reordering inside it is allowed; archived cards don't count
the cards quota counts every card of the team, archived cards and archived projects included, and is checked before the WIP limit
the due job emits card.due once, actor null and via schedule, on the first request at or after the start of the dueDate
the due job is rescheduled by a new dueDate, cancelled by null, a past date or a delete, and skipped for completed or archived cards
GET board cards lists non-archived cards by column position then card position; ?columnId filters; a foreign or empty column is 400
PATCH changes only the given fields and updatedAt, and emits card.updated with the sorted body fields
the response shows the state after the rules ran while the event snapshot does not; rule changes follow with their own via, actor and audit
viewers get 403 on every card write; API keys need the write scope for card writes and act with the owner's role
the card error order: 404 unseen column, 403 role, 400 body, invalid_assignee, invalid_field_value, field_required, then the 409s
deleting a card deletes its comments, checklist, attachments and dependencies, and emits card.deleted with the card as it was
comments come back as trees: top-level oldest first, direct replies oldest first, to any depth
parentId must be a comment on the same card; body is 1 to 5000 chars; a comment emits comment.created and leaves the card's updatedAt
mentions follow the regex and membership rules, in order of first appearance, without duplicates
mentions are recomputed on PATCH; a handle change only affects mentions written after it
PATCH is for the author only (403 even for the owner); an author demoted to viewer can still edit and delete
DELETE is for the author or admin+; another member gets 403
delete is soft and keeps the replies; writes to a deleted comment are 409 comment_deleted and to an archived card's comments 409 card_archived
GET /me/mentions lists the caller's live mentions newest first, across teams; leaving hides them and rejoining shows them again
GET /me/mentions pages with limit and cursor (default 20); a bad limit or cursor is 400 invalid_query
a handle counts only while its user is a current member of the card's team, in any role
q matches term prefixes in titles, descriptions and non-deleted comments; every term must match
score is the sum over terms of 3*t + d + c, highest first, ties by creation order
without q, and between equal scores, results come in card creation order
tokenizing lowercases and splits on every non-alphanumeric character; a q with no terms is no condition
projectId, boardId and columnId narrow the results; ids from elsewhere simply match nothing
assigneeId filters by assignee, and assigneeId=none means unassigned
label may repeat; values are trimmed and lowercased and the card must have every label
dueFrom and dueTo are inclusive and exclude cards without a dueDate; bad dates are 400 invalid_query
cards of archived projects are searched only with includeArchived=true; archived cards never
cursor pagination visits every match exactly once, in order, with total on every page
invalid queries answer 400 invalid_query: limit, cursor, q length and term count
search never returns another team's cards; viewers may search, non-members get 404
priority, sprintId (and none), category and blocked filter the results; bad values are 400 invalid_query
a cursor belongs to its route: one issued by another paginated route is 400 invalid_query, as are empty limit and cursor
create returns the secret, no other route does, a generated secret has at least 32 chars; the webhooks quota counts inactive ones
url and events are validated against the event table; events are de-duplicated and sorted, and any list with * is stored as [*]
PATCH and rotate-secret move updatedAt; later deliveries are signed with the new secret; DELETE removes the webhook
a delivery POSTs the documented body and headers, signed with HMAC-SHA256 of the exact body
every documented request event fires exactly once with its data, and cascades emit nothing
events of rule actions carry via { type: rule, ruleId, runId } and the rule creator as actor, queued after the triggering event
the events filter is respected; inactive webhooks get nothing but test pings
a failed attempt is retried after retryDelaysMs with the same body bytes and an incremented attempt header
exhausted retries mark the delivery failed after 1 + retryDelaysMs.length attempts
a timeout or a connection error fails the attempt with lastStatusCode null and a non-empty lastError
deleting a webhook cancels its pending retries; deactivating one does not
deliveries are listed newest first with cursor pages; members, viewers and non-admin-scope keys get 403 on every webhook route
GET /health answers { ok: true } without auth and carries no rate-limit headers
counted requests carry x-ratelimit-limit, -remaining and -reset for the fixed window
the spec example: limit 2, windowMs 60000, clock at 1000000
a 429 has no other effect and is not counted
budgets are per credential: two tokens of the same user count separately, and an API key apart from its owner's tokens
public routes (GET /plans included), unknown routes and 401s carry no rate-limit headers and are not counted
the rate limit comes right after authentication: requests refused at 3a, 3b or later are counted, and so is a replay
a request answered 429 still runs the scheduler's due jobs first
the data file holds version 2 and the new state, pipeline effects included, as soon as a mutating response arrives
a new app on the same file sees exactly the same state
after a restart the next card number continues, unexpired tokens and API keys work, revoked, deleted or expired ones stay invalid
the file never holds a plain-text password or API key secret, and webhook secrets survive a restart
a missing file is an empty state, and the file is created on the first write
createApp throws synchronously on invalid JSON and on an unsupported version
pending jobs survive a restart: a due job and a recurrence run when they are due on the new app
rate-limit counters, delivery records, idempotent responses and cursors do not survive a restart
a 1.x file is copied byte for byte to <dataFile>.v1.bak and rewritten as version 2 before createApp returns
migrated users keep their ids and 1.x passwords; emails are trimmed and lowercased
handles are derived from emails in file order, with collisions (_2) and padding of short handles
teams, roles (manager/editor/reader) and members are migrated, owner first, on the defaultPlan; the audit log starts empty
boards get their columns, WIP limits and categories by position; cards land in their column, or the first one, ordered by `order`
card fields: labels from tags, dueDate from UTC timestamps, description from notes, assignee only for owner/admin/member, 2.0 defaults
card numbers follow createdAt per project, ties in file order; the next number continues and new cards sort last
comments keep parentId only for a parent on the same card, and mentions are recomputed with the migrated handles
a migrated card gets a due job only when the start of its dueDate is later than now() at load
team, member, plan and project writes each append one entry with the documented action, target, details and via
board, column, card (archive and restore included) and comment writes append their entries
webhook writes append entries; test pings, reads and failed writes add nothing
failed requests, reads, /me routes, watching, dry-run imports and cascades add nothing
the log is newest first and pages with limit and cursor; a bad limit or cursor is 400 invalid_query
?action= and ?actorId= filter exactly and combine; values that match nothing give an empty list
admin+ only: members and viewers get 403, non-members 404; the log goes with its team
rule actions append their own entries after the request's, as the rule's creator with via rule
scheduler jobs: a recurrence run appends card.created via the recurrence, the trash purge card.purged with no actor, the due job nothing
every new kind of change appends one entry with its documented action, target and details
create answers the key with its secret: trk_ and at least 32 alphanumerics, prefix its first 12 chars
list and get show the caller's own keys, oldest first, and never a secret
create validates name, scope, teamId and expiresAt; expiresAt is stored as an ISO string
PATCH changes name and expiresAt and moves updatedAt; scope or teamId in the body is 400
DELETE revokes a key at once; another user's key id is 404 on every :keyId route
a user holds at most 20 keys: the 21st is 409 quota_exceeded { apiKeys, 20, 20 }, after validation
a key acts as its owner: createdBy, authorId, the audit actorId and the event actorId are the owner's id
a key has its owner's role at the time of the request: a demotion takes effect at once and a promotion restores access
a key expires when now() >= expiresAt; clearing expiresAt with a session token brings it back
api_key_not_allowed: a key may never log out, change /me, the password, API keys, or accept an invitation, whatever its scope
a team-restricted key may not create a team; an unrestricted write key may, as its owner
3a comes before the body and path checks: api_key_not_allowed before 413, invalid_json and 404, then insufficient_scope
insufficient_scope: a read key on every kind of write, checked before the path resources
routes whose Role starts with admin+ or is owner need an admin key, GETs included; other writes need write
scope and role are separate: a member's or a viewer's admin key still gets 403 forbidden from the role check
the /me routes a key may use follow the method rule: GETs need read, POST and PUT need write
a team-restricted key sees only its team: other teams and everything in them are 404, and GET /teams lists one team
a team-restricted key's mentions, notifications and unread count leave out the other teams
a team-restricted key's activity, timer and invitations leave out the other teams
a team-restricted key keeps working when its owner leaves the team, and then sees nothing of it
an unrestricted key follows its owner's membership: removed means 404, re-added with another role means that role
only the exact secret authenticates: a forged key with a real prefix, a truncated or extended secret are 401
teamId must name a team the caller belongs to; after that team is deleted the key still authenticates and sees no team
GET /plans is public and lists free, team and business with exactly the limits table, keys in table order
GET /teams/:teamId/plan answers plan, limits and usage with the seven keys in table order; a new team is on the free plan
the defaultPlan option is the plan of every new team, shown on the team and its plan
defaultPlan applies to migrated teams, whose usage is counted from the 1.x data and whose quotas apply from then on
usage counts archived projects and cards, inactive webhooks, disabled rules and inactive recurrences
storageBytes is the size of the distinct sha256 values among the team's attachments; a delete frees bytes only when no copy is left
the projects quota: a free team's fourth project is 409 quota_exceeded, checked after validation and key_taken, archived projects counting
the cards quota counts every card of the team, archived ones included, and comes before wip_limit_reached, also on template instantiation
the members quota: a free team holds 5 members; it is checked after user_not_found and already_member
pending invitations count toward the members quota on create, not counting one to the same email; accept checks the members alone
the webhooks quota is checked after validation: a free team holds 2 webhooks, inactive ones included
the rules quota is checked after validation: a free team holds 3 rules, disabled ones included
the recurrences quota is checked after validation: a free team holds 2 recurrences, inactive ones included
the storageBytes quota: an upload that would pass 1 MiB is quota_exceeded, but bytes the team already stores always pass
the fixed checklistItems limit: 50 items per card is quota_exceeded with resource checklistItems, whatever the plan
the fixed apiKeys limit: 20 keys per user is quota_exceeded with resource apiKeys, whatever the plan
the fixed fields limit: 30 custom fields per project is quota_exceeded with resource fields, even on the business plan
PUT plan upgrades and downgrades and answers the new plan, limits and usage; the team shows the new plan
PUT plan is owner only (403 for admins, members and viewers, 404 for non-members) and plan must be free, team or business
a downgrade over the new limits is 409 downgrade_blocked listing those limits in table order, and changes nothing
setting the plan the team already has answers 200, changes nothing and appends no audit entry, whatever the usage
a plan change is audited as team.plan_changed with from and to, and quotas follow the new plan at once
PUT plan needs an admin-scoped key before 404 and ignores Idempotency-Key; a POST refused by a quota stores no idempotent response
a repeated POST with the same key and body replays the status and exact body bytes with idempotency-replayed: true, and does nothing else
the same key with different body bytes is 409 idempotency_conflict, even when the JSON means the same
an Idempotency-Key must be 1 to 100 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_.:-], else 400 invalid_header
a response that is not 2xx stores nothing: after a failure the same key and body run again
the scope is (user, method, path, key): another path or user is unrelated, another credential of the same user is not
a stored response expires after idempotencyTtlMs: until then it replays, from then on the request runs and stores anew
stored responses are not persisted: after a restart the same key and body run again
PATCH, PUT and DELETE ignore the header, even an invalid one
the public POST routes ignore the header: register validates nothing of it, login issues a new token every time
a replay answers what was stored even after the state changed, including a 204 and a 202, with no new effect
3b sits after 3a and before the body and path checks: a replay skips them, invalid_header and idempotency_conflict come first
a replayed POST runs no pipeline: no second rule run, notification, activity entry or delivery, on routes of several areas
a field has the documented shape; select options are stored trimmed, other types store [], required defaults to false
a field name is trimmed, 1 to 50 chars, and unique within its project compared case-insensitively
type must be one of the eight types and never changes: a PATCH with type is 400 invalid_body
options are required for select and multiselect (1 to 50 distinct trimmed strings of 1 to 50 chars) and forbidden for other types
fields list oldest first; viewers read, members and viewers get 403 on definition writes, non-members 404
PATCH a field renames it, sets required and options, and moves updatedAt; a name another field holds is field_name_taken
at most 30 fields per project: the quota is checked after field_name_taken and freed by a delete
text values are trimmed to 1 to 500 chars; number values must be finite JSON numbers
date values are real YYYY-MM-DD dates; checkbox values are booleans and false is a stored value
select values equal an option exactly; multiselect values are non-empty arrays of options, de-duplicated in options order
user values are ids of current team members in any role; url values are absolute http or https URLs of at most 2000 chars
invalid_field_value names the first offending key in body order, unknown keys and keys of other projects included
on card create customFields must be an object, null for a field of the project is ignored, and the default is {}
PATCH merges customFields: a value sets that field, null removes it, keys not given are kept
PUT and DELETE of a card value answer the card, move updatedAt and emit card.updated with fields [customFields], even with nothing to change
PUT needs a non-null value; a field of another project, an unknown field or an unknown card is 404 not_found first
card create validation order: invalid_body, then invalid_assignee, then invalid_field_value, then field_required
a required field without a value on card create is 400 field_required naming the first missing field in creation order
removing a required value by PATCH null or DELETE is field_required; making a field required checks nothing
a PATCH of options removes stale select and multiselect values from cards and templates, without updatedAt changes or events
deleting a field removes its values from cards and templates and disables the rules that reference it
search field.<id> on text, select, date, url and user matches the value exactly; multiselect matches containment and repeats must all match
search field.<id> on number and checkbox validates the value; checkbox false matches false or unset only in the field's project; unknown fields match nothing
a set_field rule action succeeds, is a noop when the value is already there, and fails invalid_field_value once its option is removed
when a user leaves the team, user-type field values naming them are removed from cards and templates by cascade
field writes are audited: field.created, field.updated with the sorted body fields, field.deleted; a failed write adds nothing
an archived project answers 409 project_archived on field definitions and values; an archived card answers card_archived; validation comes first
API keys: field definitions need an admin key, checked before 404; value writes need write scope; a key acts with its owner's current role
an Idempotency-Key replay of POST fields answers the stored field and creates nothing; another body with the key is idempotency_conflict
a set_field action runs as the rule's creator: its own audit entry and a card.updated event via the rule, after the request's
a label has the documented shape: the name trimmed and lowercased, the color stored lowercase with #888888 by default
label names must be 1 to 30 chars after trimming; colors must be # followed by 6 hex digits
label names are unique within the team, also on rename (409 label_taken); another team may reuse a name
labels are listed by name ascending; viewers read; members and viewers get 403 on writes; non-members get 404
creating a label changes no card, and card labels need not be in the catalogue
a PATCH of the color only changes the color and updatedAt; a PATCH needs an updatable field
a rename rewrites the labels of every card of the team, archived projects and archived cards included, de-duplicated and re-sorted
a rename emits no events and appends only its own label.updated entry
a rename rewrites the labels of templates and recurrences
a rename rewrites label conditions and add_label / remove_label actions of rules, which stay enabled
a rename rewrites the label values of saved views, and the view's cards follow
a delete removes the name from the labels of cards, templates and recurrences and from saved views, without updatedAt changes or events
a delete disables every rule that uses the name in a condition or an action, definition unchanged; other rules stay enabled
merge rewrites the merged name into the target's everywhere, rules included and not disabled, deletes the source and answers the target unchanged
merge needs intoLabelId naming another label of the same team, else 400 invalid_body, and changes nothing
label writes are audited: label.created, label.updated with sorted fields, label.merged with into, label.deleted
API keys: label writes need an admin key, checked before 404; a team-restricted key does not see another team's labels
an Idempotency-Key replay of POST labels answers the stored label and creates nothing; the key with another body is idempotency_conflict
adding a blocker answers the dependency and makes the blocked card blocked, not the blocker
blockerId must be a card of the same team, in any of its projects, and not the card itself
adding the same dependency twice is 409 dependency_exists
a direct two-card cycle is 409 dependency_cycle with details.path from the new blocker to the card
the spec example: with C blocked by A and B blocked by C, adding A blocked by B answers path [B, C, A]
dependency_cycle reports the breadth-first path, visiting each card's blockers in link creation order
blocked is true only while an open blocker exists: a completed or archived blocker is not open
a blocked card cannot move into a done column (409 blocked) but may move between done columns and out of one
on move, 409 blocked comes after card_archived and before wip_limit_reached
the move_to_column action fails with blocked on a blocked card and moves an unblocked one, as the rule's creator
blockers and blocking list cards in the order the dependencies were created, archived cards included
DELETE of a blocker answers 204 and unblocks; a card that is not a blocker of it is 404 not_found
project_archived applies when either card is in an archived project; reads still work and unarchiving restores writes
card_archived applies when either card is archived, after project_archived
deleting a card removes the dependencies that involve it, in both directions
deleting a project removes every dependency that involves one of its cards
dependencies emit no events and are audited as dependency.added and dependency.removed on the blocked card
viewers read the lists but get 403 on blocker writes; non-members get 404
a column becoming a done column completes its cards and so unblocks the cards they block; turning it back blocks them again
blocked follows the dependencies on every card read: the board list and search blocked=true|false
API keys: a read key gets 403 insufficient_scope on blocker writes even for an unknown card; a write key acts as its owner
an Idempotency-Key replay of POST blockers answers the stored dependency and adds nothing; without the key a repeat is dependency_exists
a new sprint is planned and has the documented shape; the name is trimmed and goal defaults to empty
sprint validation: name 1 to 100 chars trimmed, goal at most 500 chars, real dates with endDate >= startDate
sprints list by startDate ascending then creation order, filter by ?state (default all), and other values are invalid_query
sprint routes: viewers read, members may only change a sprint's cards, admin+ manages sprints, non-members get 404
start makes a planned sprint active with startedAt now and committedPoints from its non-archived cards, null counting 0
start answers sprint_state unless the sprint is planned, and sprint_active while another sprint of the project is active
complete answers sprint_state unless the sprint is active; its body must be a JSON object
complete sets completedPoints from completed non-archived cards and carries open non-archived cards to a planned sprint
complete without carryOverTo leaves the open cards in no sprint, without changing their updatedAt
carryOverTo must be another planned sprint of the same project, else 400 invalid_body
a completed sprint is frozen: no card enters or leaves it by POST cards, DELETE cards or a card PATCH of sprintId
PATCH of a planned sprint changes any field, checks the date pair after the change and moves updatedAt
PATCH of an active sprint may change name and goal and resend its dates; other dates are sprint_state; a completed sprint is sprint_state
DELETE removes only a planned sprint; its cards get sprintId null by cascade, without updatedAt changes or events
POST sprint cards adds the listed cards, answers the sprint's cards by number, and leaves cards already in it alone
POST sprint cards emits card.updated with fields [sprintId] per changed card in body order, and one sprint.cards_added entry
POST sprint cards that changes no card answers the cards but appends no audit entry and emits nothing
POST sprint cards moves a card from another planned or active sprint into this one
cardIds must be a non-empty array of at most 100 distinct ids of non-archived cards of the sprint's project
DELETE of a sprint card clears sprintId, moves updatedAt, emits card.updated [sprintId] and appends sprint.card_removed; a card not in it is 404
an archived card keeps its sprint, leaves the sprint's card list, and removing it is 409 card_archived
a card's sprintId is null or a planned or active sprint of its project; PATCH sprintId is audited and emitted as card.updated
GET sprint cards lists its non-archived cards by number ascending, however they joined
burndown has one entry per date; dates after today are null; remaining sums points of cards not completed before the end of each date
burndown reads the current cards: a reopened card counts on every past date, and a card added later counts too
velocity lists completed sprints most recently completed first, takes the first count, and rounds the average to 2 decimals
velocity ties on completedAt put the later-created sprint first; no completed sprint gives average null; a bad count is invalid_query
sprint writes are audited: created, updated with sorted fields, started, completed with carryOverTo, deleted; failed writes add nothing
start and complete emit sprint.started and sprint.completed with the sprint snapshot; carried-over cards emit nothing
an archived project answers 409 project_archived on every sprint write, before sprint_state; reads still work
the add_to_sprint action puts the card in the active sprint as the rule's creator, and fails not_found when there is none
API keys and idempotency on sprint routes: admin+ routes need an admin key before 404, card lists a write key, and a replay creates one sprint
deleting a sprint disables the rules whose add_to_sprint action references it; a rule using active stays enabled
